name: yanifend
description: Collect and act on website visitor feedback: questionnaires, hosted forms, answers, notifications.
long_description:
YaniFend collects structured visitor feedback on any website through a friendly conversational widget — a one-line embed for custom sites, SPAs and WordPress, plus hosted stand-alone feedback pages.

This extension connects Claude to your YaniFend account so you can design questionnaires (text, options, ratings and more), fine-tune the widget, create hosted forms, pull collected answers for analysis, and manage notification channels (Telegram, Slack, email …) — all scoped strictly to your own account. Destructive tools are annotated so Claude asks before deleting.
